about_the_game:
Wilba quit his job as a soldier in the kingdom and returned to his hometown.

But then, the Demon King ordered his forces to launch surprise attacks and plunder the surrounding villages. The Demon King's army stormed Wilba's house and stole the Super Plow, a family heirloom passed down for generations.

Thus, Wilba set out on a journey to the Demon King's castle to reclaim the stolen Super Plow.

Gameplay

The game progresses by clearing one stage to advance to the next. Defeat the boss waiting at the end of each stage!

Use two attack methods: sword swings and javelin throws. Jump to dodge enemy attacks and eliminate foes hindering Wilba.

Defeat the Demon King's forces across all 4 stages.

Combat and Items

Defeating enemies grants experience points and money. Accumulate enough experience to level up and make Wilba stronger!

Also, use your money to purchase necessary items from the village shop to prepare for battle.

Buy and use recovery potions to restore HP and food items that temporarily boost stats while in the village.

Discover useful items in the chests scattered throughout.
